issues.detail: The Greek 'οσα' (how many/what) refers to the *extent* or *amount* of suffering, but the Vietnamese 'là bao nhiêu' (is how many) changes the structure from 'I will show him [the amount] he must suffer' to 'I will show him that [the number of people who] must suffer is how many.' This creates a grammatical ambiguity regarding whether the 'how many' refers to the quantity of suffering or a count of people.
